{{Top|leg}}
The '''neutronium edge''' was an enhanced melee weapon [[Edge (weapon)|edge]] that had been augmented by the addition of the highly durable and resilient [[Neutronium/Legends|neutronium]]. The strength of this edge allowed for substantial injuries, thus increasing the chance to incapacitate the enemy quickly. This edge was available in several versions ranging from basic to superior, depending on the mass of neutronium used in production.
